say:2:1410428001:1.text: May Her Majesty's mercy grant them peace.
say:2:1410428001:1.source_cn: 愿仁慈的女王为他们带去安宁。

choice_prompt:3:1410428001.text: May Her Majesty's mercy grant them peace.
choice_prompt:3:1410428001.source_cn: 愿仁慈的女王为他们带去安宁。

say:4:1410428002:0.text: They went south. Bethwyn's condition... it was too dangerous.
say:4:1410428002:0.source_cn: 往南边走了。贝丝薇的情况……太危险了。
say:4:1410428002:0.male: They went south. Bethwyn's condition... it was too dangerous.
say:4:1410428002:0.female: They went south. Bethwyn's condition... it was too dangerous.

say:5:1410428003:1.text: Caiden would be the first to suffer if she lost herself to corruption.
say:5:1410428003:1.source_cn: 如果贝丝薇突然孽化的话，凯登就是第一个遭殃的人。
say:5:1410428003:1.male: Caiden would be the first to suffer if she lost herself to corruption.
say:5:1410428003:1.female: Caiden would be the first to suffer if she lost herself to corruption.

say:6:1410428004:1.text: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.
say:6:1410428004:1.source_cn: 为了大家伙的安危，凯登不得不带她走。
say:6:1410428004:1.male: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.
say:6:1410428004:1.female: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.

choice_prompt:7:1410428004.text: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.
choice_prompt:7:1410428004.source_cn: 为了大家伙的安危，凯登不得不带她走。
choice_prompt:7:1410428004.male: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.
choice_prompt:7:1410428004.female: He had no choice but to take her away for everyone's safety.

say:8:1410428005:1.text: Haven't you seen the wandering monsters outside the city? They... were once us.
say:8:1410428005:1.source_cn: 你没见过野外那些游荡的怪物吗？它们……曾是我们。
say:8:1410428005:1.male: Haven't you seen the wandering monsters outside the city? They... were once us.
say:8:1410428005:1.female: Haven't you seen the wandering monsters outside the city? They... were once us.

say:9:1410428006:1.text: The corruption eats away at the mind until nothing remains but hunger. The worst part is...
say:9:1410428006:1.source_cn: 他们被罪孽吞噬，失去理智，而最可怕的是——
say:9:1410428006:1.male: The corruption eats away at the mind until nothing remains but hunger. The worst part is...
say:9:1410428006:1.female: The corruption eats away at the mind until nothing remains but hunger. The worst part is...

say:10:1410428007:1.text: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.
say:10:1410428007:1.source_cn: 他们会将孽化传播给他人，只有女王的恩典才能对抗。
say:10:1410428007:1.male: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.
say:10:1410428007:1.female: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.

choice_prompt:11:1410428007.text: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.
choice_prompt:11:1410428007.source_cn: 他们会将孽化传播给他人，只有女王的恩典才能对抗。
choice_prompt:11:1410428007.male: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.
choice_prompt:11:1410428007.female: It spreads. The corrupted infect the living. Only the Queen's divine grace can keep it at bay.

say:12:1410428008:0.text: Of course. Her Majesty holds the greatest magic in the world.
say:12:1410428008:0.source_cn: 当然是因为女王陛下她拥有最伟大的魔法了。
say:12:1410428008:0.male: Of course. Her Majesty holds the greatest magic in the world.
say:12:1410428008:0.female: Of course. Her Majesty holds the greatest magic in the world.

say:13:1410428009:0.text: But once you bear the Stigma of Judgment, you are cut off from her blessing. Poor Bethwyn...  She was such a kind girl.
say:13:1410428009:0.source_cn: 只是，被施予惩罚印记后就不能再享受这份恩典了……唉，可...
say:13:1410428009:0.male: But once you bear the Stigma of Judgment, you are cut off from her blessing. Poor Bethwyn...  She was such a kind girl.
say:13:1410428009:0.female: But once you bear the Stigma of Judgment, you are cut off from her blessing. Poor Bethwyn...  She was such a kind girl.

say:14:1410428010:1.text: And Caiden... so honest and devoted... I'll pray for them.
say:14:1410428010:1.source_cn: 还有诚实的凯登，我会为他们祷告的。
say:14:1410428010:1.male: And Caiden... so honest and devoted... I'll pray for them.
say:14:1410428010:1.female: And Caiden... so honest and devoted... I'll pray for them.

say:15:1410428011:1.text: Oh, radiant Queen Seralyth, our light in the darkness...
say:15:1410428011:1.source_cn: 伟大的奈萨雷斯女王，我们的信仰与希望之源……

say:16:1410428012:1.text: Hear this humble prayer and protect those two lost souls.
say:16:1410428012:1.source_cn: 请您聆听卑微仆从的祈祷，庇护那两个迷失的灵魂。

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 恩典灵露为什么能避免孽化？
